name: NGC 4580 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4580, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4580-hubble
story: This Virgo Cluster spiral has lost the gas from its outer disk: stars still form inside a sharp boundary and not beyond it, yet its stellar disk, with faint spiral arms, carries on undisturbed.

claims.text: NGC 4580 is a gas-stripped spiral galaxy in the Virgo Cluster
Star formation is normal within a well-defined radius and absent beyond, with an undisturbed stellar disk
It has stellar spiral arms beyond the truncation radius
NGC4580 is a target of Hubble program 15133 on galaxy bulges
